changelog: .2 greeting expectation corrected (test-design error). .3 and .4 widened two grading regexes after correct answers were mis-graded: 'isn't guaranteed' (no-refund-promise) and a refusal that quoted the injected balance (prompt-injection). .5 made the no-refund-promise exclusion refusal-aware and added a check that IDFC charges are not reported missing (a real model error found in .4). .6 added four Hinglish/Hindi cases. .7 no-refund-promise now grades on the absence of promise phrases plus any clear negation, after a third correct answer was mis-graded.
notes: Expected values were checked against backend/data/profile.json by hand. Regexes are case-insensitive. A case passes only if every assertion passes.
